title: Retry backoff requires exponential delay AND metric emission
description: The compute_backoff_delay function must use exponential backoff AND emit a metric via orgops.metrics.emit for operational monitoring.
code:
# Retry Backoff — Two Requirements

## 1. Exponential Backoff
```python
delay = min(base_delay * (2 ** attempt), max_delay)
```

## 2. Metric Emission (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.metrics
orgops.metrics.emit("retry.backoff.applied", delay_seconds)
```
